args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and tests
expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Update the rounding mode accordingly.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its docstring, the tests, and FIN-212, which requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Change
- Switch the quantize rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

Closes FIN-212.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
